title: Concept: Selenium Grid status endpoint disclosed
description: A reachable Selenium Grid status document advertises a ready automation hub with registered browser nodes. Sessions started there run inside the network that hosts the nodes, with the browser keeping whatever credentials the node profile carries.
applicability: Responses served by a Selenium Grid hub, router or standalone container.
risk: An attacker opens a browser session on a Grid node, reaches internal services and any saved credentials in the node profile, and can keep a foothold that looks like ordinary test traffic.
